name: all_difficult
plain_language: Any region GIAB flags as hard for short reads (repeats, duplications, low mappability, extreme GC)

name: not_difficult
plain_language: Everything outside the difficult regions: the "easy" genome

name: lowmap_or_segdup
plain_language: Places where short reads cannot be placed uniquely: low mappability or segmental duplications

name: not_lowmap_or_segdup
plain_language: Everything outside low-mappability and segmental-duplication regions

name: homopolymer
plain_language: Runs of a single base (7 bp or longer), where sequencing and alignment slip

name: tandem_repeat
plain_language: Short sequences repeated back to back

name: segdup
plain_language: Segmental duplications: long stretches present in two or more near-identical copies

name: low_mappability
plain_language: Regions where reads of typical length map to more than one place

name: gc_extreme
plain_language: GC content below 25% or above 65%, where coverage tends to drop
